title: Grade
description: How well an answer meets a clinician's note on the case, and why.

points.description: How well the answer meets the note, from 0 (not at all) to 2 (fully).

why.description: Why, in one or two sentences.
examples: It reaches the note's reading of the case and its essential actions.
It gets the reading right but leaves out an action the note calls for.
It misses what the note leads with.
